description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.09.2016 - 02.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically setting currency conversion rates for import/export transactions. The content involves legal authority exercised under existing legislation to modify operational requirements, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure change or other specialized category.
